title: The Way, The Truth, and The Promise
paragraphs: "Don't let this shake you. You trust God, don't you? Trust me. There's plenty of room for you in my Father's house. If that weren't true, would I have told you I'm going to get a room ready for you? And since I'm going to get your room ready, I'll come back and get you, so you can live where I live. And you already know the road I'm taking."
Thomas said, "Master, we have no idea where you're going. How can we know the road?"

Jesus said, "I am the Road—and the Truth, and the Life. No one gets to the Father except through me. If you really knew me, you'd know my Father too. From now on, you do know him. You've even seen him!"
Philip said, "Master, show us the Father, and we'll be satisfied."

"You've been with me all this time, Philip, and you still don't get it? To see me is to see the Father. So how can you ask, 'Where is the Father?' Don't you believe I'm in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I speak to you aren't just words. I don't make them up on my own. The Father who lives in me turns each word into a divine act.

"Believe me: I am in my Father, and my Father is in me. If you can't believe that, believe what you see—these works. The person who trusts me will not only do what I'm doing but even greater things, because I, on my way to the Father, am giving you the same work to do that I've been doing. You can count on it. From now on, whatever you ask in line with who I am and what I'm doing, I'll do it. That's how the Father will be seen for who he is in the Son. I mean it. Whatever you ask in this way, I'll do.

"If you love me, show it by doing what I've told you. I'll talk to the Father, and he'll give you another Friend, so you'll always have someone with you. This Friend is the Spirit of Truth. The godless world can't receive him, because it has no eyes to see him and doesn't know what to look for. But you already know him, because he's been staying with you—and he'll even be in you!

"I won't leave you orphaned. I'm coming back. In just a little while the world won't see me anymore, but you will see me—because I am alive, and you're about to come alive. At that moment you'll know for certain that I'm in my Father, and you're in me, and I'm in you.
"The person who knows my commands and keeps them—that's who loves me. And whoever loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and make myself clear to him."
Judas (not Iscariot) said, "Master, why are you about to reveal yourself to us but not to the world?"

"Because a loveless world," said Jesus, "is a blind world. If anyone loves me, he'll carefully keep my word, and my Father will love him—and we'll move right into the neighborhood! Not loving me means not keeping my words. The message you're hearing isn't mine. It's the message of the Father who sent me.

"I'm telling you these things while I'm still living with you. The Friend, the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send at my request, will make everything clear to you. He'll remind you of everything I've told you. I'm leaving you well and whole—that's my parting gift to you. Peace. I don't leave you the way you're used to being left—feeling abandoned, empty. So don't be upset. Don't be distressed.
"You've heard me say, 'I'm going away, and I'm coming back.' If you loved me, you'd be glad I'm on my way to the Father, because the Father is the goal and purpose of my life.

"I've told you this ahead of time, before it happens, so that when it does happen, the confirmation will deepen your belief in me. I won't be talking with you much longer like this, because the ruler of this godless world is about to attack. But don't worry—he has nothing on me, no claim on me. But so the world will know how completely I love the Father, I'm carrying out my Father's instructions down to the last detail." Get up. Let's go. It's time to leave here.
